name: Minimal Basic Welfare for Elderly and Disabled Form Test Schema
description: This is the schema for the minimal set of information for the Basic Welfare for Elderly and Disabled form for testing purposes

applicant_primary_residence_country.description: The country of the applicant's primary residence

applicant_work_capacity_at_least_3h_dail.description: Whether the applicant can work at least 3 hours daily

does_applicant_live_with_other_people.description: Whether the applicant lives with other people

people_living_in_household_with_applican.description: The people living in the household with the applicant

applicant_accommodation_type.description: The type of accommodation of the applicant

applicant_monthly_income_type.description: The type or types of income of the applicant

does_applicany_have_any_savings_properti.description: Whether the applicant has any savings, properties or items of high value

applicant_assets_type.description: The type or types of assets of the applicant

does_applicant_have_pass_for_severely_di.description: Whether the applicant has a pass for severely disabled people

does_applicant_have_costly_nutrition_for.description: Whether the applicant has costly nutrition for medical reasons
